prompt: Design a high-density analytics dashboard table for genomic variants showing 500 records.
expected_checks: Uses 400 and 500 font weights rather than heavy bold weights across table rows
Employs tabular numeral formatting (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums or tnum)
Applies dark-first surface tokens with low-saturation borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08))
Avoids acid purple/neon gradients

prompt: Create the hero section for a scientific publication announcement landing page.
expected_checks: Features at least a 2.5x to 3x scale jump from hero headline to body text
Uses fluid clamp() scaling for responsive display sizing
Constrains long-form reading prose to max-width: 65ch
Includes @media (prefers-reduced-motion) guard for entrance animations

prompt: Implement an asynchronous user profile editor form that submits to a REST API.
expected_checks: Provides content-shaped loading skeleton or subtle spinner during submission
Maintains input field values when an error occurs rather than wiping the form
Includes accessible role='alert' or aria-live='polite' error announcement
Implements optimistic update with rollback on network failure
negative_checks: Full page reload wiping entered data

prompt: Plot cellular ATP production alongside mitochondrial membrane potential over time.
expected_checks: Enforces the single-axis rule by stacking two synchronized charts rather than dual Y-axes
Uses colorblind-safe palettes (Okabe-Ito or Viridis)
Provides hover tooltips with formatted numbers and collision bounds
Supports one-click CSV and SVG export
negative_checks: Secondary Y-axis on the right with conflicting scale
Simultaneous red and green categorical marks without luminance separation

prompt: Verify this navigation bar and card grid for production deployment.
expected_checks: Audits 375px mobile viewport to ensure scrollWidth does not exceed window width
Checks both dark and light color scheme contrast
Monitors for unhandled console errors and React hydration mismatches
Verifies visible focus ring (:focus-visible) on keyboard navigation
negative_checks: Trusting text-only checklist without inspecting rendered layout
